# My Hugo Site

> A blog using the Frobiovox theme


## Posts

- [The Quiet Tao of Cat Naps](http://localhost:1313/posts/2026/05/23/the-quiet-tao-of-cat-naps/) (2026-05-23): A demo post showcasing hero, full-width, and inline image styles using Creative Commons cat photos.
- [Diagrams with Mermaid](http://localhost:1313/posts/2026/05/23/diagrams-with-mermaid/) (2026-05-23): How to drop a diagram into a post without leaving Markdown.
- [A tiny state machine in Go](http://localhost:1313/posts/2026/04/22/a-tiny-state-machine-in-go/) (2026-04-22): When you don't need a library: a 40-line state machine using a map of transitions.
- [Things I learned this week](http://localhost:1313/posts/2026/03/18/things-i-learned-this-week/) (2026-03-18): Six small things that surprised me — Hugo output formats, JSON-LD, pixel-font smoothing, and more.
- [A short note on naming things](http://localhost:1313/posts/2026/02/03/a-short-note-on-naming-things/) (2026-02-03): Two paragraphs on why most variables don't need clever names.
- [WebGL with three.js](http://localhost:1313/posts/2024/01/25/webgl-with-three.js/) (2024-01-25): Did you know that 3D is possible on the web with WEBGL? You did? Oh, well, go checkout Three.js then.
- [Typography, Fonts, and Why Monospace Headings Work So Well for Developer Blogs](http://localhost:1313/posts/2024/01/20/typography-fonts-and-why-monospace-headings-work-so-well-for-developer-blogs/) (2024-01-20): Here&rsquo;s another post to show how multiple posts look in the theme.
